decisions.reason: The existing acceptance standard already requires compliance with the brand guidelines; the caption-specific revisions do not change the batch size, source content, or acceptance-standard reference.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the clean-and-simple editing style and prohibition of distracting effects, so no additional or augmented Event is required.
The source does not change the required 30–90-second duration range.
Caption color, font, and effects requirements do not alter the permitted source material, topic constraint, moment-selection criteria, or one-video batch rule.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the newly specified complete-lesson-or-story types and standalone-comprehension requirement.

A same-message MODIFY already records the instruction to redo all three clips after reviewing the revised guidelines and examples; the caption changes do not otherwise alter the clip count or acceptance condition.
The source concerns the later requalification submission and does not retroactively change the initial three-clip trial requirement.
The caption presentation changes do not modify the requirement that selected moments have effective hooks.
The source does not change the target of 125 approved clips per month.
